Research (checked against the game code): hold an item listed under "Research items" or "Research output" and you can research the recipe once you have two thirds of its highest craft skill, rounded, minimum 1 (a level 5 recipe researches at 3, a level 9 one at 6). You only need that level in any one of the recipe's skills. With no craft skill, it uses the auto-learn level instead; level 0 means any level. Inventive takes 2 off research and 1 off auto-learn (shown in brackets). K = tool is kept, not used up.

iAdd it to your saved builds
1. Copy the line.
2. Close Project Zomboid (or stay on the main menu).
3. Open C:\Users\<you>\Zomboid\Lua\saved_builds.txt (Mac/Linux: ~/Zomboid/Lua/saved_builds.txt).
4. Paste the line on its own new line and save.
5. In character creation, pick it from the Select to load dropdown.

The route from nothing to an advanced forge, based on Retanaru's Build 42.8.1 Metalworking Tech Tree and his video guide From Stone To Steel In B42.8.1 (twitch.tv/retanaru · youtube.com/@Retanaru). Recipes, skills and components below are read live from the current game files (1 Nov 2026), and anything that's changed since 42.8.1 is flagged. It assumes you craft most things; looting lets you skip a lot. Some recipes may have easier alternatives now.
